# Security policy

Report a vulnerability in Stemcells privately: open this repository's
**Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Please don't open a
public issue for it.

Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and what it lets someone do. The fix
ships through the app's own update, and the advisory credits you unless you
would rather it didn't.

## Scope

Stemcells' own layer and how it runs: the app, its server, its update path,
and the scripts in this repository.

A flaw in T3 Code's engine that affects T3 Code as well belongs with T3 Tools,
under their [security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy). Tell us here
too, privately, so Stemcells can carry the fix.

## Supported versions

The newest build of `main` and the newest release tag. Stemcells updates
itself, so a fix reaches every install that keeps updating.
